epic.idea:
## Problem

Littlelist users should be able to optionally assign a due date to a task, view that date in their task list and manage it when editing a task. Existing tasks without due dates must remain supported.

records.text: Proposed policy, awaiting human confirmation: permit any valid calendar date, including today and past dates. This does not yet define overdue presentation or calendar-date interpretation.

Should users be allowed to assign a valid calendar date in the past, as well as today or a future date? I recommend allowing all three; this avoids preventing users from recording tasks that are already overdue.
Due dates remain optional. Any valid calendar date is permitted, including past dates, today and future dates. A date must not be rejected simply because it is in the past.

source.quote:
Yes. Allow any valid calendar date, including past dates, today and future dates.
Due dates are optional. Do not reject a date simply because it is in the past.

records.text: Explicitly confirms the proposed permission for past, current and future valid calendar dates; other proposed semantics remain undecided.

source.quote:

Due dates are optional. Do not reject a date simply because it is in the past.

records.text: Proposed, unconfirmed: an unfinished task is overdue only when its due date is earlier than today on the user device. Show an explicit Overdue label with a subtle warning color; today is not overdue. Preserve existing list ordering.

Proposed, unconfirmed: due dates are calendar dates without a time, interpreted against the device local calendar, with no UTC conversion that shifts the selected day. Reject impossible calendar dates, preserving the previous saved value and showing a clear validation message.
Proposed, unconfirmed: completing a task retains its due date but removes overdue emphasis. Reopening the task restores overdue indication when the retained date is before today.

Proposed, unconfirmed: date editing and clearing use existing autosave behavior. Clearing removes the optional date. Cancel discards only unsaved or invalid drafts; previously autosaved changes remain saved.

Do you confirm the proposed defaults together: overdue only for unfinished tasks dated before device-local today, text plus subtle warning color without reordering; date-only local-calendar interpretation with invalid dates rejected while preserving the saved value; completed tasks retain dates without overdue emphasis, restored on reopening; and edit/clear follows existing autosave and cancel-draft behavior?

David Krzystek (declared Requester) explicitly confirms: Overdue: unfinished tasks with due dates before today display an "Overdue" label and subtle warning styling. Today is not overdue. Existing task ordering remains unchanged.

source.quote:
I confirm all four proposed defaults as my explicit business decisions:

- Overdue: unfinished tasks with due dates before today display an "Overdue" label and subtle warning styling. Today is not overdue. Existing task ordering remains unchanged.

records.text: David Krzystek (declared Requester) explicitly confirms: Date interpretation: use calendar dates in the device's local calendar without timezone-related date shifts. Invalid dates must be rejected without overwriting the last valid saved value.

records.text: David Krzystek (declared Requester) explicitly accepts all four proposed date-behavior defaults. This resolves the bundled Discovery question and does not approve a subsequent artifact or lifecycle transition.

source.quote:
I confirm all four proposed defaults as my explicit business decisions:

- Overdue: unfinished tasks with due dates before today display an "Overdue" label and subtle warning styling. Today is not overdue. Existing task ordering remains unchanged.
- Date interpretation: use calendar dates in the device's local calendar without timezone-related date shifts. Invalid dates must be rejected without overwriting the last valid saved value.
- Completed tasks: retain their due dates without overdue emphasis. Reopening restores the overdue indication when applicable.
- Editing and clearing: follow the existing autosave behavior. Clearing a due date is supported. Cancel discards only unsaved or invalid drafts; previously saved changes remain.
